title: Cut and publish the v0.16.0 foundation release (naming correspondence, tiered smoke, hygiene)
goal: Six PRs merged after the v0.15.0 tag: frontend/backend naming and directory correspondence (#371), smoke-suite de-duplication (#372), smoke tiering plus per-module split (#373), the SonarCloud smells the split re-surfaced (#374), a dev-dependency DoS fix (#370) and an empty-directory removal (#375). None changes a consumer-facing interface. Package them as a minor foundation release (v0.16.0) with release notes, changelog, README/STATUS alignment, an immutable tag and a GitHub Release, without relaxing any gate.
findings: Per docs/VERSION_MANAGEMENT_GUIDE.md section 2.3, '架构优化（不影响消费仓）' and '质量门禁增强' are minor-version triggers, so the naming correspondence (#371) and smoke tiering (#373) put this release on a minor bump (0.16.0), not a patch. Section 2.4 patch is limited to security/bug fixes; only the dev-only dependency fix (#370) qualifies there and is too thin to justify a patch release on its own.

Consumers (pantheon-ops) only consume immutable tags (docs/designs/FOUNDATION_RELEASE_MODEL.md section 2.2), and minor versions are 'upgrade on demand'. Because no contract, route, permission code, menu seed or i18n key moved, no consumer is forced to upgrade.

v0.15.0's release bundle under releases/pantheon-base-v0.15.0/ is gitignored (releases/*/ is ignored except v0.13.0), so the committed release artifacts are VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE_NOTES_vX.Y.Z.md, README(zh/en), .harness/STATUS.md and the harness task packet. The GitHub Release for v0.15.0 carries no assets, so v0.16.0 mirrors that: tag plus a release-notes body.
No mechanical gate pins README/STATUS/CHANGELOG text to VERSION, so the version alignment is a convention upheld by review, not by a checker.

in: README.md / README.en.md version tables and delivery-status line
out: Any source, contract, workflow or gate change: the release records work already merged to main
Relaxing or editing release-gate.yml, .sonarcloud.properties or any required check

acceptanceCriteria: VERSION reads 0.16.0 and README (zh/en), CHANGELOG and .harness/STATUS.md all point at pantheon-base-v0.16.0.
RELEASE_NOTES_v0.16.0.md states the release is a minor, internal-engineering release with no consumer-facing interface change and no migration beyond v0.15.0.

The harness task packet exists with manifest, evidence (commands.json, summary.md, review.md) and the docs/harness task doc, and all harness gates pass (adoption --strict, task-packet, front-matter, doc-links, doc-inventory, sync-drift, method-health, template-health).
check-pr-governance passes locally and the PR's required checks plus Release Gate are green on the release commit.
The immutable tag pantheon-base-v0.16.0 is created on the release commit and a GitHub Release is published from RELEASE_NOTES_v0.16.0.md.

commands: cat VERSION && grep -n 'pantheon-base-v0.16.0' README.md README.en.md CHANGELOG.md .harness/STATUS.md
node scripts/harness/check-task-packet.mjs --root . && node scripts/harness/check-doc-frontmatter.mjs --root . --strict && node scripts/harness/check-doc-links.mjs --root . --strict
gh pr checks <n> --watch && gh release create pantheon-base-v0.16.0 --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES_v0.16.0.md
runtimeEvidence: VERSION and README/CHANGELOG/STATUS grep showing pantheon-base-v0.16.0
hosted required checks plus Release Gate conclusion on the release commit
